model: Ride-A-Long Bike Trailer/ Co-Pilot Bike Trailer 20
description: The Supercycle Ride-A-Long Bike Trailer/ Co-Pilot Bike Trailer, 20-in Wheels, Kids, Grey, is perfect for active families. This ride-along bike has a single-speed drivetrain with 20 inches (50.8 cm) wheels. It features durable steel construction and attaches quickly and easily to adult bicycles. The bicycle trailer is ideal for weekend adventures or commuting with kids. Thanks to the easy design, kids can simply pedal or just sit back and enjoy. This single bike trailer includes adjustable seat height and a padded handlebar for extra comfort and a controlled grip.
